messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] P1: p99 latency spike /v1/generate (us-west-2) > 3s sustained for 8m. Error rate stable, but streaming stalls observed. Paging on-call: @alice.kim :rotating_light:

alice.kim: on it. grabbing traces + perf graphs. any customer reports?

mateo.rivera: I see p95 up to 1.2s, p99 ~ 3.6s, spike aligns with a deploy 9m ago (eng-runtime v2.3.4).

jon.patel: streaming stalls specifically for longer-context requests (>2048 tokens). smaller requests look fine.

priya.singh: support-bot flagged 2 enterprise timeouts to Zendesk — VIP customers. adding to incident tracker.

alice.kim: checking cache metrics. redis-prefix-hit-rate down from 88% to 12% after deploy. looks like prefix keys not matching.

mateo.rivera: confirm. prefix_hash_version used by runtime changed to v2 in the last commit. keys now look like `prefix:v2:<sha>` but warm cache was populated with `prefix:v1:<sha>` variants.

jon.patel: that explains miss storm -> more cold-path decoding -> larger batch sizes / KV cache thrash -> tail latency. streaming stalls due to frequent KV reloads.

alice.kim: mitigation idea: toggle runtime flag to fallback to v1 hashing (compat mode) to restore hits, then gradually repopulate cache with v2 keys. can we flip without full rollback?

mateo.rivera: yes, there's a runtime feature-flag `enable_prefix_v2`. I can flip it in us-west-2 quickly. patch command: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/flags/enable_prefix_v2?env=us-west-2&value=false -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'`

priya.singh: also advise route-level fallback: set routing policy for heavy customers to use small-context model variant (model-x-small) until warm cache. reduces p99 for them.

alice.kim: executing flag flip now. posting logs...

IncidentBot: action log: feature-flag-change by alice.kim at 1779001410 - set enable_prefix_v2=false in us-west-2

mateo.rivera: seeing immediate improvement in redis hit rate: 12% -> 67% within 45s. p99 trending down.

jon.patel: streaming stalls reduced. p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 750ms now. still above baseline but acceptable for now.

support-bot: Notified affected customers via templated message. Ticket IDs: ZD-7341, ZD-7342.

alice.kim: root cause draft: runtime change in prefix hashing (v2) introduced incompatible cache keys. deploy rolled without cache migration/dual-write. on cold cache, miss storm increased tail latency for long streaming requests.

mateo.rivera: follow-ups: (1) add dual-write mode for hash migration (2) add canary to validate cache hit-rate post-deploy (3) rollback gating: if prefix-hit-rate drops >15% in 5m, auto-trigger rollback or flag toggle.

jon.patel: quick temp fixes we used: feature-flag fallback (done), routing to small-context model for VIPs (applied), and warming script to populate v2 keys via background fanout.

priya.singh: I'll coordinate outreach & summarize customer impact. Draft note: "We observed elevated latency affecting streaming responsiveness for larger generations starting at 09:03 PDT due to cache key mismatch after an internal deploy. We applied a runtime compatibility toggle at 09:10 PDT which restored cache hit rates and reduced latencies. No model outputs were corrupted. Support is following up with impacted customers."

alice.kim: prepping postmortem skeleton. assigning owners: RC (mateo.rivera), mitigation doc (alice.kim), customer comms (priya.singh), infra changes PR (jon.patel).

mateo.rivera: adding quick diagnostics we used for future automated runbook:
```
# check redis prefix hit rate
redis-cli -h redis-usw2 INFO keyspace | grep prefix
# sample keys
redis-cli -h redis-usw2 KEYS 'prefix:*' | head
# runtime flag status
curl -s https://ops-api/flags/enable_prefix_v2?env=us-west-2 | jq .value
```

jon.patel: timeline note for handoff: initial alert 1779001234, deploy 1779001200, paging 1779001234, flag flip 1779001410, stabilization 1779001550. Leaving a quick handoff: system stable but keep monitoring p99 and redis hit-rate for 2h.

alice.kim: will stay on for 30m then hand off to @mateo for overnight. updating #oncall-log.

mateo.rivera: taking handoff at 1779001867. summary for next on-call (flat string): "Cache-mismatch induced latency spike. Compatibility flag toggled off to restore v1 hashing. Need dual-write migration plan and canary gating before re-enabling v2. Watch redis prefix hit-rate and p99 for streaming endpoints; warm cache if we re-enable. Contact list: alice.kim, jon.patel, priya.singh."

priya.singh: adding post-incident items to tracker and creating communication thread for affected accounts.

alice.kim: incident closed (mitigated) at 1779001867. will convert to postmortem draft and link tickets. :white_check_mark:
